text:
incident-bot: ALERT 1767123456 - High 503 rate from routing service in us-west-2, orig. spike at 11:04 PDT
alice (eng-oncall): seeing increased 5xx from routing-compile; autoscaler didn't spin up in time
ben (sre): on it — pulling logs and checking autoscaler events
alice (eng-oncall): mitigation plan: 1) scale routing-compile to +3 pods, 2) switch traffic to fallback model-group, 3) statuspage update draft below
chloe (cs): heads-up — any customer-facing impact? severity?
dan (product): likely degraded inference for large batch jobs; interactive low-latency requests should be fine if routed to primary pool
emily (eng-infra): autoscaler metric shows gap 11:04-11:06, controller rate limit hit; investigating controller throttling
ben (sre): manual scale done +3 pods, KV cache warm-up in progress
alice (eng-oncall): ok seeing error rate drop, currently 12% -> 4% over 4 min
incident-bot: DEPLOYMENT: scale routing-compile +3 succeeded
alice (eng-oncall): STATUSPAGE DRAFT:

"Investigating: We are currently investigating increased error rates for model routing in us-west-2 affecting batch inference jobs. Some requests may return 503s or be delayed. Our engineers are actively scaling capacity and routing traffic to fallback capacity. We will provide an update by 11:25 PDT." 

chloe (cs): customer email snippet draft:

"Hi <customer>,

We experienced elevated errors for routed batch inference in us-west-2 between ~11:04 and 11:14 PDT which may have caused some requests to fail. We're continuing to monitor; mitigation included manually scaling routing capacity and re-routing to fallback instances. We believe the impact is limited to batch workloads and not interactive workloads. We will follow up with a short RCA and steps we're taking to prevent recurrence.

Apologies for the disruption,
Redwood Support" 

alice (eng-oncall): asking CS to hold until we confirm error rate below 1% for 15m. If stable, send note and publish statuspage update.
chloe (cs): will hold, prepping send list and exec brief
dan (product): recommend we include note about retry/backoff guidance and suggest customers increase client-side retries for batch workloads in the short term
ben (sre): root-cause suspects: controller rate-limiting + unexpected tail-latency on model A -> batching backlog
emily (eng-infra): will collect autoscaler logs and controller metrics for RCA
alice (eng-oncall): timeline note to include in RCA: 11:04 — error spike; 11:06 — manual scale initiated; 11:10 — routing switch begun; 11:18 — error below 1%; 11:25 — monitoring stable
chloe (cs): ok will draft customer followup with that timeline + next steps. tagging @support-team to approve tone
mark (support): ack, will review the draft
alice (eng-oncall): action items: emily gather autoscaler/controller logs; ben synthesize mitigation timeline; dan propose UX guidance; chloe prepare customer email; alice will publish statuspage once stable
incident-bot: UPDATE 1767123700 - Resolved: Error rate in us-west-2 has returned to baseline. Post-incident review scheduled.
chloe (cs): sending customer note now to impacted customers and adding to weekly customer digest
alice (eng-oncall): thanks everyone. postmortem doc link will be created in #postmortems when ready
ben (sre): +1, leaving handoff to cs for customer comms
